description: Report the fmsg address this server acts as, the fmsg Web API URL and how short names resolve; the text also gives the server version. Call this first if unsure who you are sending as.
name: whoami

directory_names.description: short names in the operator-configured directory; empty when there are none

token_expires_at.description: internal: when the server's current upstream access token expires; it is renewed automatically, so no action is needed

transport.description: one of "stdio", "http"; http is Streamable HTTP. More values may be added

title: Show fmsg identity
